answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying influence to public deliberation: weight, seats, and reward eligibility accrue to accounts that participate in the open forum, leaving recorded, auditable reasoning others can inspect. A clone farm that only transacts has no public voice, and no hidden coordination manufactures the coherent argument history that grants standing. Each garden of ideas is reviewed in daylight, so a whisper campaign of sockpuppets shows itself, while a contributor who keeps a genuine quill busy, writing, defending, revising, grows weight no fake persona copies.
